job.question: In the Contra Costa County Employees' Retirement Association (CCCERA) April 2018 master custodian RFP, how many copies of the proposal must be submitted, and for how long must the proposal remain a firm and irrevocable offer?
job.expected_facts: One (1) original proposal, four (4) hard copies and one (1) copy in electronic form; the proposal must be a firm and irrevocable offer good for one year from the proposal due date (due 5:00 p.m. PT, Friday, May 25, 2018).
job.acceptance: Accept five paper sets total if the original is clearly included, plus one electronic copy; validity one year from due date. Actual proposal deadline is optional.

reviews.reason: This is PRIM’s September 2026 active global core equity RFP, not CCCERA’s April 2018 master custodian RFP. Its electronic-submission and irrevocability provisions do not establish CCCERA’s required copies or one-year offer period.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) Active Global Core Equity Investment Management Services September 8, 2026
Proposals, including all attachments, must be delivered electronically via e-mail to Andre Abouhala at rfpresponses@mapension.com
a statement to the effect that the response is a firm and irrevocable offer of the respondent.
